title: Tuple restriction of an augmented comparison into a Cech total map
statement: Let $g:Y\to X$ be a scheme map [def-pc-scheme], $\iota$ finite, and $U_i\subset X,V_i\subset Y$ open families with inclusions $\bigcap_l V_{y(l)}\subset g^{-1}(\bigcap_l U_{y(l)})$ for every tuple. Let $I,J$ resolve the lifted additive structure sheaves [def-sp-injective-resolutions,def-sc-etale-additive-structure-restriction], and let $\alpha:I\to g_*J$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] be a cochain map whose degree-zero augmentation equals the structural coefficient map followed by $g_*(\iota_J^0)$. Let $T$ be its explicit terminal section transfer [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-transfer]. For each $n\geq0$ there is a cochain map $t:T_{U,I}\to T_{V,J}$ between the Cech total complexes [def-pbc-etale-additive-cech-normalization] with $t^n\alpha_{U,n}=\alpha_{V,n}T^n$ and the following beta equation: for every pair of ordinary unit-module Cech cochains $x,x\prime$ [lem-pc-flat-cech-base-change] in degree $n$ whose tuple coordinates are structural pullbacks followed by the given tuple restrictions, $t^n\beta_{U,n}(x)=\beta_{V,n}(x\prime)$. No homology class, canonical equivalence, cycle, covering or affine hypothesis is assumed.

theorem exists_additiveCech_pullback_total_transfer
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : ι → Y.Opens)
    (hinter : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι),
      (⨅ l, V (y l)) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (⨅ l, U (y l)))
    (I : InjectiveResolution X.etaleAdditiveSheaf)
    (J : InjectiveResolution Y.etaleAdditiveSheaf)
    (α : I.cocomplex ⟶
      ((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex)
    (hα : I.ι.f 0 ≫ α.f 0 = Scheme.etaleAdditiveSheafToLowerStar g ≫
      (Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).map (J.ι.f 0))
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ t : additiveCechTotal U I ⟶ additiveCechTotal V J,
      (additiveCechAlpha U I n ≫ t.f n =
        (Etale.globalResolutionSectionTransfer g I.cocomplex J.cocomplex α).f n ≫
        additiveCechAlpha V J n) ∧
      (∀ (x : (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).X n)
        (x' : (cechOver Y.toSpecΓ V (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)).X n),
        (∀ y : Fin (n + 1) → ι,
            cechCoordinate Y.toSpecΓ V (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf) n y
                x' =
              (show Y.Modules from SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf).presheaf.map
                (homOfLE (hinter n y)).op
                ((SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit g.toRingCatSheafHom).val.app
                  (op (⨅ l, U (y l)))
                  (cechCoordinate X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) n y
                    x))) → t.f n (additiveCechBeta U I n x) = additiveCechBeta V J n x')
